name: visual-diff
description: Dependency-free visual diff of a running app against 1× design exports (Figma or Paper), the script behind the diorama-visual-review skill. Each case opens a route, drives it into the design's state with Playwright, screenshots the page or one element at DPR 1, crops element references to their opaque box (shadow bleed) or an explicit refCrop, compares on a canvas in the same browser and writes ref/actual/diff PNGs plus report.html with a wipe slider. Cases module (--cases, default scripts/visual-cases.mjs), references folder (--refs, default design/references), output (--out, default visual) and BASE_URL are configurable; Playwright is resolved from the app, which needs it as a dev dependency.
